report: kept     resources/gfx/ui/completion_widget.anm2: the mod's own - the port's code reads this file by layer and frame number from the copy the game loads, the mod's included, and steps aside where it has not what it needs; the sheets it cuts are the mod's layout, whatever their size; Completion Mark Reminder (TWEAKS) leaves a mod's widget alone unless the mod also brings gfx/port_completion_widget.png and port_completion_widget_pause.png cut for it

json.name: Cooler Completion Marks [REP+]
json.author: Unknown
json.description:
Replaces completion mark icons with colored counterparts so you can identify the completion quicker. Normal mode completion marks are grayscale.

For Repentance: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3373844445
For Mini Pause Menu+: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3361529372

[h1][b]Disclaimer:[b][h1]
[h2][b]After subscribing to the mod open the game, enable the mod and restart the game[/b][/h2]
[h2][b]If the Delirium mark is broken on tainted characters then you are most likely using the Mini Pause Menu+ version of this mod, the fix is available on the mod's page above[b][h2]
